summary: Full backend + frontend testing of CGT Estimate tab feature (TaxTrack AU). All CGT functionality verified: 4 tabs present, holding period timeline, 50% discount badge, cost base breakdown, market value inline editor, capital gain/loss display, taxable gain, all 4 ATO bracket rows, ATO disclaimer, property form with 3 new CGT fields. Backend stores and returns new fields correctly. Depreciation tab regression passed.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/properties/{id} uses PropertyCreate model with model_dump() — if client sends partial data (only current_market_value), optional fields reset to null. Frontend correctly sends all fields in PUT payload, so this is not a runtime issue, but could be fragile if another client sends partial PUT.
